chunks: Whatever is in it from al-Nuʿmān al-Rāzī, I have transmitted it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from al-Ḥasan ibn Muttayl al-Daqqāq, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, from Muḥammad ibn Sālim, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from al-Nuʿmān al-Rāzī.

key_terms.النُّعْمَانِ الرَّازِيِّ: Al-Nuʿmān al-Rāzī, the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement of direct transmission by the compiler
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ: Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan, an early transmitter in this sanad/isnad
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ: Muḥammad ibn Sinān, a transmitter in the chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to al-Nuʿmān al-Rāzī in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from al-Nuʿmān al-Rāzī. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission for hadith attribution in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh.
